verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents a first-party pre-commit hook extension explicitly framed around preventing secrets and security issues from entering Git history, matching the story almost verbatim, and community/hands-on evidence corroborates that Semgrep scans run locally/offline without uploading code. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation specifically of the pre-commit hook workflow (not just CLI scanning) and any discussion of its performance/false-positive tradeoffs in that specific context.
